decision: Authenticate the fixed original daemon and its executable/socket once, then use one Status reply as the candidate owner source within this same job. Prove the unique kernel child, at most three unique parent-child edges, true namespace init, unchanged init executable content, and original four-role capture before qualifying a bounded framework observation.
server_side_effect_scope: Existing Status implementation polls active child and may perform ip netns pids/getprop; natural cleanup of an already-exited child is disclosed, no lifecycle write is requested.
resource_gate: Original five Main limits and required OOM/pids counters preserved before and after capture.
success_does_not_establish: Future stability, exit cause, current helper generation or whole-app production readiness.
